capability: Every miss becomes a new kind of check
title: Turn every miss into a gate.

hook.picture: Close: a line glows through a screen-icon gate and goes to a printer pod, which prints it with the end sliced off.

problem_in_viewer_words.body: It looked perfect on screen. The print got cut off.

why_it_keeps_happening.picture: The screen gate passes run after run. Three times, faster each time, a cut print comes back and a flag lands on the growing pile.
why_it_keeps_happening.words: The check only looked at the screen.

stakes.body: Every miss gets fixed by hand, one at a time, and the same kind of mistake returns next week.

solution_hint: Make each miss a new check.

metaphor.body: The flag that marks a miss is folded into the icon of a new gate, so the next run is checked for that kind of mistake too.

steps.picture: The whale picks the top flag off the pile.
It folds the flag into a new icon: a page edge.
steps.words: Fold the miss into a new check.

steps.picture: Push-in: the whale sets the page-edge icon on a new lintel behind the screen gate (a squash on placing it). A second gate stands.
The old cut run is replayed. It glows through the screen gate and stops at the page gate as the bar drops.
steps.words: The old mistake must stop here now.

steps.picture: The fixed run passes both gates and a tick lands. The used flag stays folded on the lintel.
The whale points its fin at the folded flag on the lintel.
steps.words: A miss that slipped by is an escape.

real_case.claim: In round 2 of Manu's jury, a fresh user found there was no print gate (a P0). The fix added a print gate and 32 new fail-first checks.

honest_limit.picture: A pale print passes both the screen gate and the page gate. The printer pod answers ✕ and a fresh flag falls.
honest_limit.words: The next new kind still gets through.

not_this.body: A gate only knows misses it has seen.

ending_pattern.body: The printer pod prints the bar-2 sheet again and it comes out whole under a gate whose icon is the folded flag. The whale picks up the next flag.
ending_pattern.callback: Same close on the printer pod as bar 2: the sheet that was cut now prints whole.

end_belief.body: Every miss is the start of a check.

beats.picture: Close: a line passes a gate with a small screen icon (it glows). The whale sends it to a printer pod.
The pod prints a sheet: the line's last third is sliced off at the paper edge. ✕ in copper.
The whale holds the cut sheet up to the screen gate. The gate glows as if all is well.
A copper flag falls beside the whale. Hold.
Hinge: half a bar of stillness, then the title card.
Pull back: the screen gate passes run after run.
The screen icon on the lintel pulses. Nothing on it knows about paper edges.
beats.words: The check only looked at the screen.

beats.picture: Three times, faster: three more prints come back cut. Three copper flags pile up by the whale, which fixes each sheet by hand.
Freeze on the pile of flags.
beats.words: Make each miss a new check.

beats.picture: The whale picks the top flag off the pile.
It folds the flag into a new icon: a page edge.
beats.words: Fold the miss into a new check.

beats.picture: Push-in: the whale sets the page-edge icon on a new lintel behind the screen gate (a squash on placing it). A second gate stands.
beats.camera: one push-in to z 1.3 on the decisive moment

beats.picture: The old cut run is replayed. It glows through the screen gate and stops at the page gate as the bar drops.
beats.words: The old mistake must stop here now.

beats.picture: The fixed run passes both gates and a tick lands. The used flag stays folded on the lintel.
The whale points its fin at the folded flag on the lintel.
beats.words: A miss that slipped by is an escape.

beats.picture: Wide: a line of gates. A fresh pod, a tester who didn't build it, holds up a printed sheet cut at the edge.
The card fades in on clean paper.
beats.words: Real run: a fresh tester found this gap.

beats.picture: A print gate joins the row, and a cascade of small ticks fills in behind it.
beats.words: One miss. A whole new kind of check.

beats.picture: A pale, washed-out print passes the screen gate and the page gate. Both glow.
beats.words: The next new kind still gets through.
beats.camera: still, then one slow push to what slipped

beats.picture: Slow push: the printer pod answers ✕ and a fresh copper flag falls.
beats.camera: still, then one slow push to what slipped

beats.picture: Still on the new flag.
beats.words: A gate only knows misses it has seen.

beats.picture: FELT framing restored: the printer pod prints the same sheet as in bar 2, and it comes out whole.
Above it, the page gate with the folded flag on its lintel glows.
The whale picks up the new pale flag and starts to fold it. Spark.
beats.sound: Resolved chord with a fold sound

beats.picture: A row of two gates, and the whale holding a half-folded flag, breathing.
beats.words: Every miss is the start of a check.

beats.picture: SERIES.lockup over the still line.
beats.sound: Pad tail ends in room tone

score_self.reason: The flag-to-icon fold makes 'a miss becomes a new kind of check' literal, and the whale builds the gate (REVIEW P2-5). The case is Manu's jury record. Risk: the pale-print limit is close to a colour check.
